segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid; trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding; ADR 0041 calibrated cost

trials.PR1_PAIRS_K20_Z1_U50: names with all 90 closes in cut-89..cut; rank all pairs by correlation of daily returns over cut-89..cut; take the top K=20 pairs; for each pair regress ln close_a on ln close_b with intercept over cut-89..cut, z = last residual / stdev of residuals; if z > 1.0 short a and long b, if z < -1.0 long a and short b, each leg 0.5/K; weights of all pairs are summed per name
trials.PR2_PAIRS_K50_Z15_U50: same as PR1 with K=50 and entry |z| > 1.5
trials.PG1_PEER_REVERSAL_U50: peers of each name = the 5 other U50 names with the highest daily-return correlation over cut-89..cut-14 (>= 60 valid pairs of days); signal = name's return close[cut]/close[cut-13]-1 minus the mean of its peers' same return; long the LOWEST quintile, short the HIGHEST (wide_universe_dev.pick)

decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096-0107; DSR N=3 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 reported
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +3 regardless.
